title: Professional Certificate Course in Advanced Discussion on Rational and Natural Theorists
description: To provide a comprehensive understanding of how different approaches to organization theory can shape our understanding of how organizations function and survive.
longDescription: Understand the organisation as a rational system. Defining characteristics of rationality. Selected thoughts such as Taylor, Fayol, Weber, and Simon of the rational perspective. Understand the organisation as a natural system. Differentiate Rational and natural theorists. Understand distinctive theories of organisation survival. Selected thoughts such as Mayo, Barnard, Selznick, and Parson of the natural perspective. Concluding remarks on the rational and natural system theorists. This course explores two main perspectives on understanding organisations - the rational system and the natural system - examining their defining characteristics and selected thoughts from influential theorists such as Taylor, Fayol, Weber, Simon, Mayo, Barnard, Selznick, and Parson. Through a comparison and contrast of the rational and natural system theorists, this course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of how different approaches to organisation theory can shape our understanding of how organisations function and survive.
